rules_text:
R1: Every task needs one owner from the roster, or must stay unassigned with an open question. Never invent an owner.
R2: Deadlines are facts only if stated in the meeting; any proposed date is a recommendation citing a rule.
R3: Deadlines must not fall on a weekend or before the meeting date.
R4: Missing or conflicting information must be listed as an unresolved question.
